Figure 1:Overview of DC-SAE under32×32\timesspatial compression.
(a) DC-SAE preserves reconstruction details missed by RAE and improves over DC-AE.
(b) On ImageNet512×512512\times 512, DC-SAE achieves better gFID than DC-AE.
(c) DC-SAE also provides substantially higher autoencoder throughput.

Figure 2:Pipeline of DC-SAE.
We first adapt a frozen semantic encoder to a32×32\timestoken grid.
Since the resulting semantic autoencoder suffers from poor reconstruction under aggressive compression, we introduce an unconstrained pixel branch to preserve local image details.
The semantic and pixel branches are fused and decoded by a ViT decoder with Spatial Demerger.

Figure 4:Qualitative results on ImageNet. The images are generated with512×512512\times 512resolutions in the latent space of DC-SAE under32×32\timescompression, with randomly sampled class conditions.
